title: Low block: the second bank
titleKid: Near our goal: make a wall
brief: They are pushing your team back toward your own box down the far flank.
briefKid: They are attacking down the other side, near our goal.
question: Their winger is driving into your third. Where do you go?
questionKid: Their winger is running at our goal. Where do you go?

takeaway.standard: Once they get into your third the block drops low: the midfield forms a second narrow bank just in front of the defenders, around the edge of the box.
takeaway.kid: Near our goal, drop back and make a tight wall in front of your defenders.

misconceptions.text: You stayed up the pitch, so there is a huge gap in front of your defenders for their #8 to receive in.
misconceptions.textKid: Too far up! Drop back and help in front of your defenders.

misconceptions.text: You dropped right into the back line; stay a few metres in front of it so the midfield bank screens the edge of the box.
misconceptions.textKid: Too deep! Stay a few steps in front of your defenders.
